verdict.rationale: The evidence pack references generic 'speech configuration' controls for when an assistant starts/stops speaking (vapi-docs-53) and call-timeout settings (vapi-docs-44), but nothing describes a model-based end-of-turn/endpointing system that goes beyond simple VAD silence timeouts (e.g., no mention of semantic turn-detection models, LLM-based endpointing, or similar). missing for 10: explicit documentation of a model-based/semantic end-of-turn detection feature distinct from VAD, any comparison to VAD-only timeout behavior, and evidence of it reducing interruptions for slow speakers.
